rules.statement: A wife's deed to her husband does not require the husband’s written consent under Ordinance No. 15 of 1876, section 9, if it is a voluntary grant between spouses.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not see that the husband's written consent would afford the wife any protection in her dealings with her husband himself."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 9 of Ordinance No. 15 of 1876, or null
